RunningWork.description: A job or subagent a turn left running, as its harness reported it.

description.description: What it is doing, as the harness described it.

id.description:
The harness's id for it: the one its report back names (Claude's
task id, a subagent's id).

kind.description: What it is, in the harness's word (`subagent`, `shell`, …).

oneOf.description: The person interrupted it (an abort in the harness).

The harness ended it with an error (an API failure, a refused
request): `agent_turn.error` holds the harness's own words.

Its harness session ended with the turn still open (an exit sends
no Stop).

A new harness process started with the turn still open: the one
that ran it is gone.
oxplow closed the agent session with the turn still open.
oxplow restarted with the turn still open; recovery closed it.

TurnUsage.description:
A turn's token counts, when the harness reported them with the turn
(ACP's prompt response). Claude's come from the transcript instead.

description:
`agent.turn.ended@5`: a turn closed — how (`outcome`), what it left
running, and what the token-usage reactor needs to count it (the
transcript to read, or the counts themselves).

error.description:
The harness's own words for the error that ended it (`outcome:
errored`): `name: message`.

left_running.description:
The jobs and subagents still running when it ended, when the
harness said.

title: AgentTurnEndedV5
